concept_decisions: Concept A supplies warm faceted tubular volume, comb silhouettes and tapered tail but its repeated station count and spine sizes conflict across views. Override counts using primary Description/figures: exactly6 filtering pairs and9 clawed posterior pairs;15 sclerite stations with2+14x5 spines. No centipede tergite plates, no eyes. Front is Blender-Y. Filtering limb length roughlyone-third85mm body; author20 paired fine setiform bristles per limb rather than source about30 pairs, explicitly a low-poly simplification, retain bilateral repeated chevron direction. No annulations on these anterior limbs. Rear claws hook backward +Y; rear limb annulations suggested by real radius modulation rather than surface colors. Body tiny papillae and0.1mm hairs omitted at512px; macrodiagnostics retained. Two small head plates and recessed dark terminal mouth. Head/tail and all limbs full volume, pose artistic; no substrate or stand.
